audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 through 5 read Lucian or Skill while the prose beside them describes an Irelia takeover from level 3 — whys[2] literally says 'she owns the kite now' under a row marked Lucian.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill. The mirror flipped exactly rows 1-5 in both of its layers as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: win[1..5] and phases[1..5].side flipped together, ratings moved, and phases[1..5].why rewritten. Row 6 left untouched at Lucian to match the mirror, which deliberately kept it — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet is the tracked cooldown everywhere with no number and no description of its actual shape.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 850 range and fires TWO blades that converge — only the space between them stuns. That changes the dodge from 'run backwards' to 'step out sideways', which is the difference between eating it and not.
audit.corrected: The 16s figure and the converge shape written into report[5].t, phases[2].why, wants.foe[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. Defiant Dance is described as generic burst-blocking, and Ionian Fervor is twice called armour shred.
audit.why: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge — Lucian's entire kit is physical, so it is aimed squarely at him and the page never says why. Ionian Fervor grants stacking attack speed and, at max stacks, bonus on-hit damage; it shreds nothing. A reader building armour against 'shred' is answering a mechanic that does not exist. Added: Flawless Duet immobilizes, which arms Lightslinger's two bonus-magic attacks — the mirror recorded the same interaction from Irelia's side.
audit.corrected: Physical reduction stated in whys[3], whys[4] and mid; the shred claim removed from late and wants.foe[2]; the Lightslinger trigger written into mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' names no source.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals Irelia on every cast, and its cooldown REFRESHES on a Marked target or on a kill — so against a minion wave she heals repeatedly for 15 mana. That is the sustain worth Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Bladesurge as the reason.

edits.before: This is her lane now. By 4-5 Irelia has the sustain off W Defiant Dance (which also blocks your burst when she activates it before your Lightslinger shots) and enough passive shred that your trades stop netting. Never commit a combo while her E is up — the stun chains into Bladesurge and you have no second dash to answer. At 6 her Vanguard's Edge walls off your retreat and turns a won kite into a death; your The Culling channel does nothing if she dashes out or W-blocks the volley. Farm at max range, ping for ganks, and look to leave the lane rather than win it.
edits.after: This is her lane now. By 4-5 Bladesurge heals her on every reset and Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage while she charges — that is your entire damage type, so burst into a charged W is wasted. Never commit while Flawless Duet is up: the stun chains into Bladesurge and you own no second dash. One consolation — her stun immobilizes, and Lightslinger then arms your next two attacks with bonus magic damage, so fight out rather than freeze. At 6 Vanguard's Edge walls your retreat, so farm at range and leave.

edits.before: You lose the late game outright. Irelia is a snowballing duelist who out-stats your squishy ADC frame once she has Trinity Force and Blade of the Ruined King — her passive shreds your armor, W eats your burst, and Bladesurge resets let her stick to you through every E dash you have. Your only path was converting the level 1-2 edge into a lead and ending before her items. If it went even, accept you cannot 1v1 her — group, position behind your frontline, and use The Culling to clean up fights you do not start, never to duel her.
edits.after: You lose the late game outright. Irelia is a snowballing duelist who out-stats your squishy ADC frame once she has Trinity Force and Blade of the Ruined King — Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed into bonus on-hit damage, Defiant Dance blunts your physical burst, and Bladesurge resets let her stick through every dash you own. Your only path was converting the level 1-2 edge into a lead and ending before her items. If it went even, don't 1v1 her — group, sit behind your frontline, and close fights you did not start.

notes: Ionian Fervor was described as armour shred in two places; it is stacking attack speed with a bonus on-hit at max stacks. Defiant Dance's reduction is specifically PHYSICAL, which matters more here than in most matchups because Lucian has no magic damage outside the Lightslinger immobilize trigger. Rows 1-5 flipped as one atomic group to match packet and mirror. I deliberately left the 2+ items row alone: the packet says Skill but the mirror kept Lucian there and flagged it, and changing only our side would create exactly the disagreement mirror-fix exists to catch.
